executive_summary: The vendor's proposal is extremely generic, vague, and fails to address almost all mandatory technical, architectural, timeline, and commercial requirements outlined in the RFP. Crucial components such as PostgreSQL database integration without migration, role-based access control rules, concrete project timelines (3-month pilot / 6-month rollout), support SLAs, and fixed pricing are completely omitted or deferred.
strengths: The vendor correctly identifies that NordFrame requires a web-based dashboard and low-stock notifications.
The proposal maintains a professional and polite tone.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Completely omits the mandatory requirement for existing PostgreSQL database integration without migration (REQ-03).
Fails to specify Role-Based Access Control mechanics, particularly distinguishing warehouse managers from HQ staff (REQ-04).
Omits the required timeline (3-month pilot for 1 site, 6-month rollout for all 6 warehouses), offering only vague statements (REQ-05).
Defers pricing entirely instead of providing a fixed cost within the €80,000–€120,000 budget.
Fails to provide support and maintenance terms, SLAs, or documentation of assumptions and risks (REQ-06, REQ-07).

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Mentions a web dashboard concept, but lacks any technical depth, stack details, or confirmation of real-time polling/WebSocket mechanisms.
Completely missing. No mention of PostgreSQL or connecting to existing databases without migration.
Mentions 'secure login for different users' but fails to define site-specific vs. HQ-wide access controls.
Acknowledges notifications for low stock, but lacks details on configurable thresholds or notification channels.
Fails to provide a timeline, rollout plan, or mention the required 3-month pilot / 6-month full rollout schedule.
No assumptions, risks, or limitations documented.
